args.query: prisma too many connections on vercel serverless, connection pool exhausted what do

results.title: Prisma 7 + SQLite via better-sqlite3 adapter
results.summary: Prisma Client 7 with the better-sqlite3 driver adapter, schema push and relational queries on a local SQLite file.

results.title: Prisma 7 + SQLite: nested writes, interactive transactions and unique errors
results.summary: Prisma Client 7 on SQLite (better-sqlite3 adapter): nested creates, an interactive $transaction that rolls back, and handling P2002 unique-constraint errors.

results.title: SQLModel one-to-many and many-to-many relationships tested on in-memory SQLite
results.summary: Model one-to-many and link-table many-to-many relationships with SQLModel, load them with selectinload, and test offline on in-memory SQLite with StaticPool.

results.title: zstandard trained dictionaries for many small JSON records
results.summary: Train a Zstandard dictionary on JSON records, compress single records and newline-delimited streams, and handle frame content size and dictionary mismatch pitfalls.

results.title: p-limit concurrent async job pool
results.summary: Cap parallel async work with p-limit, tracking in-flight count and collecting results in input order offline.

results.title: Vercel AI SDK tool loops, structured output and streaming with a mock model
results.summary: AI SDK generateText with a Zod-typed tool and a stopWhen step cap, Output.object structured results validated by Zod, and streamText deltas, all tested offline with MockLanguageModelV4 and simulateReadableStream from ai/test.

results.title: Knex migrations, seeds and queries on better-sqlite3
results.summary: Knex 3 with the better-sqlite3 client: in-code migrations via a custom migrationSource (latest, down, rollback, list), foreign keys enabled per connection, a transactional seed and a join plus aggregate query, tested on in-memory SQLite.

results.title: Objection.js models with Knex on SQLite
results.summary: Use Objection.js Model classes on a Knex better-sqlite3 connection with relationMappings, inserts and eager graph fetches in offline tests.

results.title: Tortoise ORM relations and filters on sqlite under pytest-asyncio
results.summary: Model foreign keys, reverse and many-to-many relations in Tortoise ORM, then exercise select_related, prefetch_related, dotted filters, distinct and annotate counts offline on in-memory sqlite.

results.title: blinker named signals for decoupled event handlers with sender filtering
results.summary: Wire named blinker signals between producers and subscribers, scope handlers to a sender with sender filtering, and test weak references, temporary connections and muting fully offline.
